subject: pe
title: Governance: IOC, FIFA, WADA
welcome_lead: Who runs global sport, and how should they answer to it?
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on sport governance and ethics.
final_note: Governance failures threaten the legitimacy of sport itself.

concepts.def: International Olympic Committee, founded 1894 by Pierre de Coubertin.
Fédération Internationale de Football Association, founded 1904.
Misuse of entrusted power for private gain (e.g., FIFA 2015 scandal).
When personal interests conflict with official duties.

walkthroughs.body_html: IOC stages Olympics; FIFA runs football; WADA enforces anti-doping code globally.
US Department of Justice arrested top FIFA officials on corruption charges in Zurich — exposing decades of bribery.
Post-scandal reforms introduced age and term limits, independent audit and integrity checks.

options: Transparency, accountability and rule of law
